images.title: A strip folded in half
images.purpose: Show that a strip 1 unit long folded once with the ends meeting opens into 2 equal parts, each 1/2 unit long.
images.composition: A short folded strip at the top and the long opened strip centred below it, with wide space between them.
images.exact_structure: Top: the strip folded once, ends meeting, drawn as one short double layer half the length of the full strip, outlined grey #6B7280. Below: the opened strip, 1 unit long, with one grey crease exactly in the middle; the left part filled teal #0072B2 and the right part filled amber #E69F00, exactly equal in length. A thin bracket spans the whole strip underneath. Exactly 1 folded strip, 1 opened strip, 1 crease, 2 equal parts.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the two parts of the strip drawn unequal, or the crease off the middle
images.takeaway: One unit folded into 2 equal parts gives parts of 1/2 unit.
images.description: A strip folded with its ends meeting, and below it the opened 1 unit strip with one middle crease making 2 equal parts, one marked 1/2 unit, with 1/2 + 1/2 = 1 unit under it.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the crease and say how long each part is, in units.

image_decisions.why: The folded strip above the opened strip shows a length measured in the unit one half.
